edges: A TV show portrayed a fictionalized version of the events involving the killer.
The killer did not choose the women at random.
The girl does not visit the dog; instead, the dog visits her.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The stray dog named Tomorrow has a special bond with a little girl who feeds him.
The story introduces us to a small street dog fondly named Tomorrow, whose memories reveal a difficult life.

edges: The killer chose and killed three victims named Cynthia.
